test_title: PYST 63: SSC GD Constable - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 23rd November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: Sita scored 756 marks out of 900 and her brother Avi scored 350 marks out of 500. How many more marks should Avi get to make his score per cent equivalent to Sita?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Sita's percentage = 756 ÷ 9 = 84%

Avi's target marks = 84% of 500 = 420 marks

Marks required to reach target = 420 − 350 = 70 marks

**∴ The correct answer is 70 marks.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sita's marks = 756 out of 900

Avi's marks = 350 out of 500

**Formula Used:**

Percentage = (Obtained Marks ÷ Total Marks) × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b5d8405721eec281f4fce710e1826140c984f261ffce0e9f52f3dc96ad70532d.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sita's score percentage = (756 ÷ 900) × 100 = 84%

⇒ To make his score percentage equivalent to Sita, Avi must also score 84%.

⇒ Avi's target marks = 84% of 500

⇒ Avi's target marks = (84 ÷ 100) × 500 = 420 marks

⇒ Current marks of Avi = 350 marks

⇒ Marks Avi needs to score more = 420 − 350 = 70 marks

**∴ The correct answer is 70 marks.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Formula

Percentage is calculated as the ratio of a specific value to the total value, multiplied by 100. Formula: (Value ÷ Total Value) × 100%.

Finding Value from Percentage

If a percentage is given, the specific value can be found by multiplying the percentage by the total base value. Formula: Value = (Percentage × Total Value) ÷ 100.

Base of Percentage

When comparing percentages of two different totals, the absolute values will differ even if the percentages are the same. The base refers to the denominator or total quantity.
